title: Custom Dimensions
description: A robust 1.21.11 Server-Side engine for creating custom dimensions and dynamic, linkable portals
body:
# 🌌 Custom Dimensions: The Multiverse Engine 🌌

**Custom Dimensions** is a high-performance, **Server-Side Only** mod for Minecraft **1.21.11**. It grants server administrators the ultimate power to create a multiverse without requiring players to download a single mod! 🛠️💎

---

### 🔄 Automatic Two-Way Portals
Never get lost in the void! 🌌 When you step through a custom gateway for the first time, the mod **automatically generates a matching return portal** at your destination. It uses the same frame material you used on the entrance side, creating a perfect, two-way link instantly! 🌀✨

---

### 📜 Command Reference 📋

| Command | Arguments | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| `/dimension create` | `<name> <type>` | Creates a new registered world. | OP 2 |
| `/dimension delete` | `<name>` | Removes a world from the registry. | OP 2 |
| `/portal link` | `<id> <frame> <igniter> <target> <color> <light>` | Creates a link between a frame and a world. | OP 2 |
| `/portal delete` | `<id>` | Unlinks and removes a specific portal. | OP 2 |

---

### 💡 Examples of Usage 🛠️

Here are some cool ways you can use **Custom Dimensions** on your server:

#### 🏆 Create a High-Stakes Arena
Want a dedicated PvP arena in a void world? ⚔️
1. `/dimension create pvp_arena void`
2. `/portal link arena_gate obsidian flint_and_steel minecraft:pvp_arena FF0000 15`
*Now, lighting an Obsidian frame with Flint and Steel takes players to a red-tinted Arena!* 🔴🔥

#### 🌿 Create a Hidden Resource World
Need a fresh Overworld for players to mine without ruining the main spawn? ⛏️
1. `/dimension create resource_world overworld`
2. `/portal link farm_gate iron_block stick minecraft:resource_world 00FF00 10`
*Use an Iron Block frame and a Stick to access a green-glowing mining dimension!* 🟢💎

#### 🌌 The "Alther" Dimension
1. `/dimension create alther void`
2. `/portal link alther_gate gold_block amethyst_shard minecraft:alther A020F0 15`
*A purple-glowing portal made of Gold and ignited with Amethyst!* 🟣✨

---

### 🚀 Why Choose Custom Dimensions?
* 🟢 **100% Server-Side:** No client downloads! Join with Vanilla. 💻🚫
* 📂 **Official Pathing:** Worlds saved in `world/dimensions/` for max compatibility. 📂📁
* 🐎 **Mount-Ready:** Ride Horses, Camels, or Donkeys through portals safely! 🐪💨
* ⌨️ **Universal Autocomplete:** Full TAB-completion for all dimension IDs. 🔍⌨️
* 🌈 **Immersive Visuals:** Simulated RGB particles and custom lighting. 💡✨
